game_title: Off By One Fixer – Mushroom Market Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, a new vine ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 230 points of vine ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Off By One Fixer
